# mtncloud_load_balancers (Data Source)

Lists your load balancers, including those made in the console. A load balancer spreads traffic across instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_load_balancers" "all" {}

output "load_balancers" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_load_balancers.all.load_balancers : x.id => { name = x.name, external_ip = x.external_ip } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Only list load balancers whose `cloud` is this (case ignored).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only list load balancers whose `enabled` is this.
- `name_regex` (String) Only return load balancers whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `type` (String) Only list load balancers whose `type` is this (case ignored).
- `visibility` (String) Only list load balancers whose `visibility` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `load_balancers` (Attributes List) The load balancers, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancers))

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the load balancer is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer is enabled.
- `external_ip` (String) External (public) IP, or empty.
- `host` (String) Host name or address, or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the load balancer.
- `internal_ip` (String) Internal IP, or empty.
- `ip` (String) Address, or empty.
- `name` (String) Name of the load balancer.
- `port` (Number) Port, or 0.
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSL is enabled.
- `type` (String) Load balancer type.
- `visibility` (String) `private` or `public`.
